name: What trends are popular in bathroom remodeling right now?

mainEntity.name: What trends are popular in bathroom remodeling right now?

acceptedAnswer.text: Current bathroom remodeling trends often emphasize functionality, comfort, and sustainable design. Popular choices include larger, curbless showers with spa-like features such as rainfall showerheads and body jets. Freestanding tubs remain a luxurious option. In terms of aesthetics, homeowners are gravitating towards natural materials like wood and stone, along with neutral color palettes for a calming ambiance. Smart technology, such as heated floors, smart mirrors, and touchless faucets, is also gaining popularity, enhancing both convenience and energy efficiency in modern bathrooms.
acceptedAnswer.description: Popular bathroom remodeling trends include large curbless showers, freestanding tubs, natural materials, neutral color palettes, and smart technology like heated floors and touchless faucets.
